description: This recreation site has a trail that circumnavigates a small lake. There is also an interpretive kiosk, and a boardwalk that cuts across the lake at one end through rushes and water lilies.
directions: Off Highway 6 in Lavington, turn north onto Nobel Canyon Road, and it immediately turns into Coldstream Forest Service Road. Continue on Coldstream FSR. At kilometer 11, turn left and travel the 1 kilometer down Ponds FSR into the Recreation Site.
title: The Ponds
